mpDrawOrderByLayer.Description: Changing the draw order of objects according to layers
mpDrawOrderByLayer.FullDescription: Processing layers marked with checkboxes in the window, changing the draw order according to the order of marked layers. An "Auto" mode is available that automatically changes the draw order of objects on one of two specified layers when creating or editing
mpDrawOrderByLayer.h13: Save the current position of layers in the drawing
mpDrawOrderByLayer.h14: Load and apply the layer position stored in the current drawing. Layers that have been added after the position is saved will be moved to the end of the list
mpDrawOrderByLayer.h15: Move the selected layer to the beginning of the list
